description: This file defines a CLI command class 'UpgradeCommand' that orchestrates the upgrade process for the OrangeHRM application, including database connection validation, system checks, migration execution, and configuration file creation.

classes.name: UpgradeCommand
classes.description: A console command class extending InstallerCommand that manages the upgrade process for OrangeHRM, including database validation, migration, and configuration file generation.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Sets command aliases and returns the command's name 'upgrade:run'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines the command-line options needed for the upgrade process such as database credentials and current version.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that handles the upgrade process, including gathering inputs, performing system checks, running migrations, and generating configuration files.

methods.name: drawDatabaseInfoTable
methods.description: Utility to display database connection details in a table format.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command line option has a non-empty value.

methods.name: throwIfParamEmpty
methods.description: Throws an exception if a required parameter option is missing or empty.
